name: myfans
description: MyFans monorepo — frontend, backend, and Soroban contracts

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix contract
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contract && npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:contract && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.prepare: npm ci --prefix backend && cd backend && npx husky install .husky
